title: Selected U.S. presidential milestones
subtitle: A small, source-backed demonstration of Inquiry's interactive timeline format. This is not a complete presidential history.
notes: The selection is intentionally incomplete and demonstrates the artifact format rather than a historical ranking.
Claims are narrowly phrased to match the cited U.S. Senate, National Archives, and Library of Congress records.

events.title: Abraham Lincoln issues the final Emancipation Proclamation
